fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

choices_zh: 农历月从新月开始，约半个朔望月后月亮转到与太阳相对的位置
十五那天月亮自己发光
questions.explain_en: New moon starts the month; about 14–15 days later the Moon is opposite the Sun and fully lit.
questions.explain_zh: 初一是新月，十四五天后月亮与太阳相对，被照亮的一面全朝向地球。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Over Kunming Lake a deep-red firework bursts. Which explanation is correct?
questions.q_zh: 昆明湖上空炸开一朵深红色烟花。哪种解释正确？
choices: Strontium salts; excited electrons emit red light as they drop
Copper salts; they reflect the lanterns
No metal; red is just smoke
choices_zh: 锶盐；受激电子回落时放出红光
questions.explain_zh: 锶的发射光谱在红光区。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Lantern posts along the bridge carry lanterns in an arithmetic pattern: 12 on the first, 18 on the second, and so on. How many lanterns are on post 20?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯杆挂灯笼成等差：第 1 根 12 盏，第 2 根 18 盏，依此类推。第 20 根有多少盏？
questions.qtype_zh: 等差数列第 n 项

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the bridge, 4 lanterns are lit, and the number of lit lanterns doubles every minute. After how many minutes are 64 lanterns lit?
questions.q_zh: 桥上先点亮 4 盏灯笼，亮着的灯笼数每分钟翻一倍。几分钟后亮着 64 盏？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Lantern strings on the bridge are hung in rounds: 4 lanterns in the first round, then 2 times as many each round, for 4 rounds. How many lanterns in total?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯笼分轮挂：第一轮 4 盏，之后每轮是上一轮的 2 倍，共 4 轮，一共多少盏？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the bridge, Flora may pick 4 of 7 different lanterns to carry home. Order does not matter. How many different sets can she pick?
questions.q_zh: 在桥上，Flora 可以从 7 盏不同的灯笼里挑 4 盏带回家，不计顺序，有多少种挑法？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Lanterns are lit in waves on the bridge: 8 at first, and the number lit multiplies by 2 each wave. How many are lit in wave 6, after 5 multiplications?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯笼一波波点亮：开始 8 盏，每一波是上一波的 2 倍。乘了 5 次之后（第 6 波）点亮多少盏？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora has 60 m of red rope to fence a rectangular lantern area at the bridge. What is the largest possible area in m²?
questions.q_zh: Flora 有 60 米红绳，要在桥头围一块长方形灯区，最大面积是多少平方米？
questions.qtype_zh: 最值优化（定周长最大面积）
